.. change::
    :tags: bug, pool, regression
    :tickets: 13738

    Fixed a regression introduced in 2.1.0rc2 where connections collected as
    part of a reference cycle on Python 3.15 would not be returned to the
    connection pool, eventually exhausting the available connections. The
    pool now accounts for the changed weak reference clearing order in
    Python 3.15, restoring garbage collection cleanup for both synchronous
    and asyncio connections.
